answer: Ground-truth-checked useful work resists Sybils because a ring cannot certify itself. Each identity receives unique, time-boxed tasks whose answers are scored against hidden ground truth, not against peer votes, so a thousand clones cannot simply vouch for one another like a walnut orchard pretending to be a forest. Copying fails: tasks differ per identity, and a zephyr of copied answers scores near zero. The attacker must solve fresh work for every identity, paying compute and time per clone, while honest work passes and is recorded on a shale-solid public ledger of who actually solved what.
